persons.name: Dhijamānsiṃha
persons.evidence: dānapati asaṃṭolahiti maṃgala jeyā tulādhara dhijamān siṃha

persons.name: Buddhimānsiṃha
persons.evidence: bhātṛ buddhimān siṃhayāta thva pustaka coyā viyā jula

relations.evidence: śrīvajrācāryayogamānvilāsāt likhāpi (!) tantraiḥ (!) kallavīrākhye || dānapati ... dhijamān siṃha

purpose: given to brother Buddhimān Siṃha (bhātṛ buddhimān siṃhayāta thva pustaka coyā viyā jula)
notes: The scribe is likely Yogamāna Vajrācārya of Ratnakīrtivihāra ('vilāsāt likhāpi' seems corrupt for vilāsena likhitam or likhāpitam). The book was commissioned/donated by the Tulādhara merchant Dhijamān Siṃha of Asan for his brother Buddhimān Siṃha.
